description: The Kokkori bridge, also called Noutsos, is a single high stone arch with a small relief opening on each side, over a rocky river in the woods south of Koukouli. It is not the three-arch Plakidas bridge. The sky is clear, about 9.7°C. The sun is still below the horizon. The gorge is unlit.
